Task.Title: Landing Page Modernizasyonu
Task.Description:
Home/Index.cshtml tam yenileme - Interactive and Bold + Marketplace Style:
Yeni Dosyalar: - wwwroot/lib/aos/aos.css, aos.js (AOS animasyon kutuphanesi) - wwwroot/css/landing.css (Landing page ozel stilleri) - wwwroot/js/landing.js (Counter, tabs, carousel, AOS init)
Guncellenen Dosyalar: - Views/Home/Index.cshtml (tam yenileme) - Views/Shared/_Layout.cshtml (FullWidth modu eklendi) - resources.tr.xml (~70 yeni landing key) - resources.en.xml (~70 yeni landing key)
Yeni Section'lar: 1. Hero - Gradient bg, animated rotating text, glassmorphism search, trust logos 2. Stats - Animasyonlu sayaclar, modern kartlar 3. Categories - Marketplace style buyuk kartlar, hover efekti 4. Value Props - Alici/Satici tab'li section, feature cards 5. Featured Products - Modern urun kartlari 6. How It Works - Step-by-step animasyonlu 7. Testimonials - Koyu arka plan, testimonial kartlari 8. New Products - Grid gorunum 9. CTA - Gradient bg, buyuk butonlar
Ozellikler: - AOS scroll animasyonlari - Counter animation (sayilar scroll'da yukarı sayar) - Glassmorphism efektleri - Floating shapes animasyonlari - Tab gecisleri (Alici/Satici) - Mobile responsive
